text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gentlemen and all fans of the
Twinkle
Series, it's the moment you've
all been waiting
for!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The ultimate race, known to all of Umamusume-kind—the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... This year's race is bound to be a
blast too.
The atmosphere alone has me
stoked to the max!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...We've finally made it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Very much so. But at the same time... I'm

exhilarated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm aching to get out onto the turf and
show
everyone what the me of the
moment can do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh no, it's you whom I've been counting on, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you—for everything you've done
for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You encouraged me to surpass my limits,
and
after all the support and guidance
you've given
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Nothing would bring me greater joy than
to win
you the title of Derby trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I shall be going now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I will!
choice_data_list: 全てを出し切ってこい！
全てを出し切ってきて！
choice_data_list_en: Give it everything you've got out there!
Give it everything you've got out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's little sister... She might
be a
strong contender. She's about to
run in the
Derby, but she doesn't look
nervous at all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Nahhh, you gotta focus on those two!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I see that you'll both pose a fine
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: There's no way I'm losing to anyone... not today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
With these two legs... with the fleeting
time
afforded me... let me become a star
that shines
ever on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I will race with every ounce of my being!
